$comment: Generated by scripts/gen-manifest.mjs from the components; do not edit

default.description: Content slide (title pinned at the top)

document.description: A long document on one slide (a spec, an ADR, a README): its own `##` headings become an index rail, and each click scrolls the text to the next section (a click on the rail jumps there). The steps count in the slide's clicks; an export shows the last section (or every one with --with-clicks).

exercise.description: An exercise or lab: its number and time on top, the task (the slide's content) on the left, and on the right how to work and what to expect, with a countdown for the time (its start button: it waits for you). Frontmatter: exercise (the number or a label), time ("15min", 15), method, expected, countdown: false.

full-dark.description: Kept for backward compatibility: dark centered slide with large heading

full-image.description: Background image or video with overlay

alt.description: What the picture shows, for screen readers (empty: decoration)

backgroundPosition.description: Same name as in full-split; `position` is kept for existing decks

image.description: An image or a video (.mp4, .webm …), or a list of up to three

imageStack.description: Several: side by side (row, default) or stacked (column)

poster.description: A video's poster: before it plays, and in exports

full-split.description: Background image or video with a text panel

alt.description: What the picture shows, for screen readers (empty: decoration)

image.description: An image or a video, or a list of up to three

imageStack.description: Several: side by side (row, default) or stacked (column)

poster.description: A video's poster: before it plays, and in exports

iframe.description: Embedded page, full or beside content

iframeTitle.description: The embedded page's name for screen readers. Not `title`: that is Slidev's slide title (overview, <Toc>), so setting it renamed the slide

poster.description: A still for exports in place of the live page (its address shows as a link either way)

image.description: An image or a video (.mp4, .webm …), or a list of up to three

imageStack.description: Several: side by side (row, default) or stacked (column)

imageWidth.description: The media column's width: "40%", 0.4, "2/5" (50% by default)

poster.description: A video's poster: before it plays, and in exports

speaker.description: About the speaker: the person on the left, the slide's text (a short bio, topics) on the right. From the slide's `speaker:` (name, role, affiliation, avatar, links), else the headmatter's, else its author and affiliation. (Not a top-level `name:`: Slidev takes that as the slide's title.)

three-cols.description: Columns with a header (default slot) and a bottom slot

two-cols.description: Columns with a header (default slot) and a bottom slot

Badge.description: variant: default blue green red yellow cyan gray |

BeforeAfter.description: Before and after, side by side with an arrow between (slots before / after: code blocks, images, text); `delta` sums up the change

delta.description: Shown under the arrow, e.g. "4× faster"

Benchmark.description: Benchmark bars: one per result, the winner lit, each with its value and how it compares to the baseline (the first)

lowerIsBetter.description: true: smaller wins (time, latency); false: bigger wins (throughput)

results.description: [{ label, value }]: the first is the baseline

BlockDiagram.description: Named blocks on a stage, and a focus frame that moves from block to block on each click, with a caption per step. The steps count in the slide's clicks (as <v-clicks>); an export shows the last one.

blocks.description: [{ id, label, sub, x, y, w, h, color }]: position and size in % of the stage

steps.description: The focus, one click each: block ids, or { block, caption }

Browser.description: A browser window: macOS dots, a tab with the title, an address bar, and the page: an image (`src`), a live page (`iframe`) or the slot

height.description: The page's height (the window's minus its bar); auto by default

src.description: A screenshot to show as the page

Chart.description: A bar or line chart, drawn in SVG (no chart library): one or several series over `labels`, in the theme's colors; it grows in once the slide has arrived (exports show it drawn)

data.description: Numbers (one series), or [{ name, values, color }]

max.description: The top of the axis; by default a round number above the largest value

ChevronFlow.description: A process as arrow-shaped steps, left to right; `active` lights one

active.description: The step to light (1-based); the ones before it read as done

ClickTabs.description: Tabs whose pane changes on each click: one window, several versions (kernel v1 / v2 / v3, C++ / Python). It looks like a code group (styles/code-theme.css) and claims its clicks from the slide, so the slide's click count includes them, as with <v-clicks>.

active.description: The tab shown first (1-based), without steps

steps.description: false: no clicks, the tabs switch on a click of their own

tabs.description: The tab labels; the panes are the slots tab1, tab2, … in this order

ComplexityTable.description: title, rows ([{ n, target, algo, complexity, highlight }]), showComplexity |

Countdown.description: minutes, size (preset sm default lg xl, or any CSS length, as <QRCode>), label, autoStart (false: a ▶ start button), showZero. Click the timer to pause / resume, double-click to reset |

autoStart.description: false: a start button; the timer starts on click

size.description: sm | default | lg | xl, or any CSS length (e.g. "2.5rem"), as QRCode

Cycle.description: A cycle: items around a ring with arrows between them, and an optional word in the middle (a loop, an orbit)

items.description: Titles, or { title, color }, clockwise from the top

DrawOn.description: Draws the lines of the SVG inside it, as if by hand, once the slide has arrived (again on each visit); exports and reduced motion show them drawn

EChart.description: An Apache ECharts chart in the theme's colors (series palette, text, grid lines), for what the SVG <Chart> doesn't draw. ECharts is an optional peer dependency: `npm i -D echarts` in a deck that uses this (Slidev only loads the components a deck uses, so others don't need it). Drawn as SVG (sharp in exports, no animation there); it plays again each time the slide is shown.

ErrorSpotlight.description: A bug story in three panels: the error, its root cause, the fix (slots error / cause / fix, Markdown and code welcome)

FloatImage.description: src, alt, caption, position (left/right), width, rounded |

Footnote.description: (slot; pinned at the bottom of the slide) |

Ghost.description: A giant faint glyph behind the slide's content: a number, a word, an emoji. Placed in a corner (or the middle), it doesn't take room.

GithubCard.description: A GitHub issue or pull request as a card (what you give it; nothing is fetched, so it works offline and in exports)

GoogleForm.description: A quiz or poll on Google Forms: a QR code and a short link so the room opens it on their phones, the form itself beside it (`embed`), and the results from a published Google Sheet chart (`results`). Exports show the QR code and the link instead of the live frames.

embed.description: Show the form beside the code

link.description: The link under the code, if not the form's own

results.description: A published Sheet chart's address (File → Share → Publish to web → the chart, embed): shown instead of the form

url.description: The form's address (its "Send" link: docs.google.com/forms/d/e/…/viewform, or forms.gle/…)

HexGrid.description: Hexagons in a honeycomb (a triad of three, or more): one idea each

columns.description: Hexagons in a row (3 items: a triad, 2 over 1)

ImageCompare.description: Two images of the same size, one over the other, with a handle to drag (or a range to set) that reveals the `after` one; exports show the split at `position`

position.description: Where the split starts, in % from the left

ImageTour.description: A walk through a screenshot (an Nsight timeline, a dashboard): one spot per click. `mode`: callout (a numbered pin and its note), mask (the rest dims) or zoom (the image zooms onto the spot). Spots are in fractions of the image (0–1), so they stay put at any size. Steps count in the slide's clicks; an export shows the last one (callouts: all pins).

spots.description: [{ x, y, w, h, label }]: the spot's center (x, y) and size (w, h), in fractions of the image

Interactive.description: Something live (its slot: an explorer, a diagram editor, a widget) that has a still for exports. In the room it shows the slot, or with `dialog`, the still, and a click opens the slot in a dialog over the slide (Esc or a click outside closes it). Exports show the still.

dialog.description: Show the still and open the slot in a dialog on click

image.description: The still, for exports (and the dialog's preview)

Lesson.description: The lesson learned: one takeaway, large, with the story behind it

LiveDemo.description: A live site in a browser bar, with a way out when the network fails: a status dot (connecting / live / offline), a "video" toggle to a recording, and in exports the `poster` image. If the page hasn't loaded within `timeout` ms (or the room is offline) it switches to the video by itself. `scale` shrinks a desktop page to fit; `crop` hides that many pixels at its top (a site's own header).

crop.description: Pixels hidden at the page's top

poster.description: The still for exports (and the video's first frame)

scale.description: The page's zoom: 0.5 shows a 2× wider page

timeout.description: ms to wait for the page before switching to the video

video.description: A recording to fall back on

LogoWall.description: Logos (sponsors, users, tools) in even rows, quiet (grey) until hovered

color.description: Show the logos in their colors (grey until hovered by default)

columns.description: Columns; by default from the count (utils/media.ts wallColumns)

logos.description: Image paths, or { src, name, url } (a name alone shows as text)

Meter.description: A meter: a labelled bar filled to value / max. With `animate` it fills once the slide has arrived (exports show it full). Thresholds can recolor it: `warn` / `danger` (as values) turn it yellow / red.

showValue.description: The number at the right: true shows "value / max" as a percent; a string is shown as is

unit.description: A unit after the percent-less value, e.g. "GB/s" (then value / max is shown)

warn.description: Values from which the bar turns yellow / red (higher is worse)

PanZoom.description: A big picture or diagram (its slot) that pans and zooms in place: the wheel or +/− zooms around the pointer, dragging pans, double-click or 0 resets. The slide's keys still work; exports show the start view.

PatternCard.description: signal, template, alternatives, sections ([{ key, label, icon, color, text }]); same-named slots for rich content |

sections.description: Replace the default sections: [{ key, label, icon?, color?, text? }]. Content comes from the same-named slot, else `text`, else the same-named prop.

Person.description: A person: avatar (or initials), name, role and affiliation, and links

avatar.description: An image path (public/ or a URL); without it, the initials

links.description: URLs, e-mail addresses, { label, url } or { github: name } (utils/contact.ts)

Phone.description: A phone: rounded body, a camera island, the screen showing an image (`src`), a live page (`url`) or the slot

src.description: A screenshot to show on the screen

url.description: A page to load live on the screen

width.description: The phone's width (14rem); its height follows (19.5:9)

PhotoWall.description: Photos in even rows, cropped to one shape, with optional captions

ratio.description: Each photo's shape, as a CSS aspect-ratio (4/3 by default)

PresenterNote.description: (slot; shown only in the presenter view, or on the slide too with class="show") |

ProsCons.description: Pros and cons side by side (a ✓ / ✗ list each)

Pyramid.description: Levels from the narrow top to the wide base (a hierarchy, the memory pyramid); each level's label can sit beside it

levels.description: Top first: titles, or { title, note, color }

QRCode.description: url (empty: this deck), slide (true: this slide, or a number), size (preset or any CSS length), caption, ecc (L / M / Q / H), api ({data}, {size} are replaced), src |

api.description: Use a QR image service instead ({data}: the encoded url, {size}: pixels)

ecc.description: Error correction L | M | Q | H; raised for free when the symbol has room

size.description: sm | default | lg | xl, or any CSS length (e.g. "150px")

slide.description: Without `url`: true links to the slide it's on, a number to that slide

url.description: What the code holds; empty: this deck's address (see `slide`)

Radar.description: A radar (spider) chart in SVG: one polygon per series over the axes

data.description: Numbers (one series), or [{ name, values, color }]

max.description: The outer ring's value (the largest value by default)

SpeechBubble.description: A speech bubble: a glass bubble with a tail toward the speaker, and an optional name (and avatar) beside it.

avatar.description: An image path (public/ or a URL)

color.description: The bubble's tint: a theme color name or any CSS color

side.description: Where the speaker is: left (default) or right; the tail points there

StackDiagram.description: A software stack, top layer first (App → cuBLAS → Runtime → Driver → GPU); `active` lights one layer, and a layer can note what it adds

active.description: A layer to light: its title or its place (1-based)

layers.description: Top first: titles, or { title, note, color }

Stat.description: value (as written: "$4.2M", "98.5%", "1,024"), label, delta ("+12%"; its sign picks ▲ / ▼), good (up or down: which way is green), count (counts up from 0 when the slide arrives; exports show the figure), color, size (sm / default / lg), plain (no card) |

color.description: primary (default), blue, cyan, green, yellow, red, gray, or a CSS color

count.description: Count up from 0 when the slide arrives (exports show the figure)

delta.description: The change, as written: "+12%", "-3.1 pts"; its sign picks the arrow

good.description: Which way is good for the delta: up (default) or down (latency, cost)

StickyNote.description: A sticky note: a small, slightly turned glass card in a color, for an aside pinned onto a slide. Place it with classes (absolute right-8 top-20) or inline.

color.description: A theme color name (yellow by default) or any CSS color

rotate.description: Degrees it is turned (−1.5 by default; 0 for straight)

StoryBox.description: title, variant (history insight warning tip person), year, source, color, icon |

color.description: Custom accent color / icon; override the variant's

TeamGrid.description: People in even rows: avatar (or initials), name, role

Timeline.description: items ([{ title, year, desc, color }]), active (a static highlight), steps (each click reveals the next item and moves the highlight; counts in the slide's clicks), animate (items fade in top to bottom when the slide arrives) |

active.description: A static highlight (index); with `steps` the newest item is highlighted

animate.description: Items fade in top to bottom once the slide has arrived (anim-fade-up)

steps.description: Each click on the slide reveals the next item (counts in the slide's clicks, like <v-clicks>)

Transcript.description: A chat or agent session, one turn per click (user, agent, tool), in a window of fixed height that scrolls to the newest turn; a badge counts the turns gone out of view above. Exports show the last turns.

start.description: Turns shown before the first click (1)

turns.description: [{ role: user | agent | tool | system, text, name }]
